program: Wingless raw-input to representation to reasoning to generation chain
question: Does changing only the canonical answer generator from previous-two-byte context to previous-three-byte context remove the R4 raw-output loop while preserving instruction representation and reasoning?
hypothesis: With R4 corpus, split, anchors, operation inference, operand decoding and 96-counter reasoner unchanged, a result-conditioned previous-three-generated-byte raw generator will exactly reproduce all eight canonical answers and raise heldout exact raw-output accuracy to at least 0.90.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: representation and reasoning pass; output shortfall is isolated to the two-byte generator, whose context graph loops on the canonical zero answer

repair_boundary.changed: raw answer generator context order only
repair_boundary.unchanged: R4 corpus, split, operation anchors/model, precision-first value anchors, operand inference, predicted-representation reasoning training, 96-counter reasoner, canonical answer bytes, lookup control, thresholds

raw_text_generator.state: per result class next-byte counts conditioned on previous three generated byte states
raw_text_generator.generation: three internal start states; argmax next byte; lowest-byte tie break; autoregressive feedback; stop after newline or 32 bytes

validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
R5 reuses R4 corpus, representation, reasoner, and lookup control unchanged.
Only generator context changes from two emitted bytes to three.
Generator training uses training answer bytes only.
Heldout generation receives predicted result class plus its own emitted bytes only.
All eight canonical outputs are checked after training.
Full Go regression passes and all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold adaptation, or post-result tuning occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and canonical generation is fixed but at least one end-to-end threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but three-byte generation does not materially improve raw output.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any corpus, representation, reasoning, inference-isolation, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: No corpus, representation, reasoner, generator context order, tie rule, state cap, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after primary output.
